supersession: The closed inventory.json must replace each evidence_request with exact checked evidence_refs and reconcile its description before the root contract. Unverified requests are not teaching authority.

features.description: Complete selected present/preterite indicative systems of witan, cunnan, ðurfan, durran, sculan, mugan and mōtan; forms resembling strong preterites have present meaning, and their pasts have the checked dental formation.
features.evidence_request: Cook124–137 and corroborating Wright/Fulk exact selected cells.
features.scope_note: Only the expressly selected forms, senses and constructions are assigned.

features.description: Complete selected dōn present/preterite indicative, including dēst/dēð, dōð and dyde/dydest/dydon.
features.evidence_request: Cook140 and Wright anomalous dōn.
features.scope_note: Only the expressly selected forms, senses and constructions are assigned.

features.description: Complete selected gān present/preterite indicative, retaining its selected singular forms and suppletive ēode/ēodest/ēodon.
features.evidence_request: Cook141 and Wright anomalous gān.
features.scope_note: Only the expressly selected forms, senses and constructions are assigned.

features.description: Complete selected present/preterite indicative system of willan with its exact personal endings and wolde past.
features.evidence_request: Cook139 and Wright anomalous willan.
features.scope_note: Only the expressly selected forms, senses and constructions are assigned.

features.description: All six bēo-series present indicative cells extend the existing wesan lemma; the earlier eom-series and wæs-series remain distinct existing records.
features.evidence_request: Cook138 and Wright copula.
features.scope_note: Only the expressly selected forms, senses and constructions are assigned.

features.description: Complete selected second-singular/second-plural imperative pairs of weakI–III models, including heavy stems, geminates, short -ian, -rwan, weakII -a/-iað and all four weakIII exceptions.
features.evidence_request: Cook95,113–124; Wright selected imperative/stem rules.
features.scope_note: Morphological production for the declared lexical roster; no new government/complement frame follows for diagnostic lexemes.

features.description: Complete selected second-singular/second-plural imperative pairs cover strongI–VII, with the exact lexical j-present, consonant, vowel-length and contracted-stem exceptions.
features.evidence_request: Cook95,101 and strong class entries; Wright rules.
features.scope_note: Use the selected present-stem imperative, not the mutated indicative2/3sg. Full pattern coverage does not promote every earlier strong lexeme to imperative recall.

features.description: Complete dō/dōð, gā/gāð and wes/wesað, bēo/bēoð command pairs; distinct indicative and imperative cells may share a spelling.
features.evidence_request: Cook138,140–141; exact imperative tables.
features.scope_note: Only the expressly selected forms, senses and constructions are assigned.

features.description: Selected plain and inflected infinitive forms, including weak -ian, j-present and contracted/anomalous stems; productive inflected targets use the explicitly selected -anne series with stated variants.
features.evidence_request: Cook95,101,119–124,138–141,199–200; Wright corroboration.
features.scope_note: Earlier citations gain new scope only by exact form assignment. Participles remain supplied; no unattested modal infinitive is generated.

features.description: Recognize missing, doubtful and unattested modal/nonfinite forms and distinguish source citation labels from attested productive paradigmatic cells.
features.evidence_request: Fulk123 and Cook modal citation notes.
features.scope_note: Displayed absent cells have no form or learning milestone. Witan command substitutes require their separate formal note and are not treated as productive subjunctive teaching.

features.description: Cunnan plus a plain infinitive expresses learned ability or knowing how to perform the taught action.
features.evidence_request: Audited cunnan ability frame and plain infinitive construction.
features.scope_note: Only the expressly selected forms, senses and constructions are assigned.

features.description: Mugan/magan plus a plain infinitive expresses the selected ordinary ability or capability to perform the taught action.
features.evidence_request: Audited magan ability frame and plain infinitive construction.
features.scope_note: No blanket equation of English can/may with one modal; permission and counterfactual nuances are not silently assigned.

features.description: Ðurfan plus a plain infinitive expresses need to perform the taught action, with present and past forms.
features.evidence_request: Audited ðurfan need frame.
features.scope_note: Only the expressly selected forms, senses and constructions are assigned.

features.description: Durran plus a plain infinitive expresses daring to perform the taught action, with present and past forms.
features.evidence_request: Audited durran dare frame.
features.scope_note: Only the expressly selected forms, senses and constructions are assigned.

features.description: Sculan plus a plain infinitive expresses the selected present/past necessity or obligation.
features.evidence_request: Audited sculan obligation frame.
features.scope_note: This does not assign an automatic future tense or a counterfactual/conditional system.

features.description: Mōtan plus a plain infinitive expresses the explicitly selected permission sense in the assigned present and past clauses.
features.evidence_request: Audited mōtan permission frame; exact past-use evidence required.
features.scope_note: Context-dependent necessity uses must be separately identified; the chapter does not reduce every occurrence to one gloss.

features.description: Willan plus a plain infinitive expresses desire or willingness; wolde can state past desire without asserting that the desired act occurred.
features.evidence_request: Audited willan volitional construction and actual source wolde+gecȳðan.
features.scope_note: Only the expressly selected forms, senses and constructions are assigned.

features.description: Witan in its assigned ordinary knowledge sense takes the independently checked nominal object construction.
features.evidence_request: Pending exact evidence for a practical nominal-object example.
features.scope_note: Only the expressly selected forms, senses and constructions are assigned.

features.description: Use the bēo present series in the independently checked elementary future/general-state construction.
features.evidence_request: Pending exact bounded example and interpretation.
features.scope_note: Do not force every bēo-series occurrence into one English tense or confuse the indicative with identical nonfinite/subjunctive spellings.

features.description: Simple preverbal ne applies to the explicitly taught noncontracted irregular/modal indicative clauses, including the selected durran and magan examples.
features.evidence_request: Audited ne+irregular examples and construction.
features.scope_note: No negative concord, new negative copula, or unassigned nillan/nytan/nabban production.

features.description: The finite modal/volitional verb carries subject agreement; its selected plain infinitive does not acquire person/number endings or tō in the taught construction.
features.evidence_request: Cook199 and exact modal frames.
features.scope_note: Only the expressly selected forms, senses and constructions are assigned.

features.description: Elementary purpose after cuman is expressed with tō plus the selected inflected infinitive; the understood actor is the person/people who come.
features.evidence_request: Cook200 cōmon … tō biddanne and source editor audit.
features.scope_note: No general purpose-clause subjunctive, indirect command, arbitrary controller or other infinitival construction.

features.description: The selected infinitives retain their audited lexical argument relations: carrying/taking/eating have accusative objects, helping a dative person, and giving an accusative thing with dative recipient.
features.evidence_request: Plain/inflected infinitive syntax plus earlier separately checked lexical frames.
features.scope_note: Only the expressly selected forms, senses and constructions are assigned.

features.description: Second-singular commands address one person; plural commands address two or more, without a separate dual ending. The subject can remain unexpressed in the selected direct instructions.
features.evidence_request: Cook imperative syntax and dual/plural agreement evidence.
features.scope_note: These are second-person commands, not third-person optative wishes or a new general politeness system.

features.description: Ne directly precedes the selected negative imperative in the taught prohibition.
features.evidence_request: Exact evidence for simple negative imperative, independent of optative prohibitions.
features.scope_note: No general claim that every Old English prohibition must have imperative morphology.

features.description: The prior cweðan direct-quotation frame now also introduces the independently taught second-person commands. Quoted reference belongs to the speaker/addressee context.
features.evidence_request: Prior Cook cweðan speech plus actual source command quotation.
features.scope_note: Only the expressly selected forms, senses and constructions are assigned.

features.description: Faran means go/travel in an ordinary intransitive clause and as the action in the newly taught volitional complement.
features.evidence_request: Fresh lexical government check; earlier finite table/gloss alone did not assign the frame.
features.scope_note: No destination, vehicle, motion-preposition or sailing sense is implied.

features.description: Cuman means come in an ordinary intransitive clause and supplies the movement verb before the selected same-subject purpose infinitive.
features.evidence_request: Cook200 actual cōmon plus purpose; ordinary cuman lexical frame.
features.scope_note: No unassigned destination phrase or sense of becuman follows.

features.description: Gān is used in the selected ordinary objectless go clauses, modal complements and direct commands.
features.evidence_request: Audited gān lexical frame.
features.scope_note: Source intō and other destination phrases remain supplied unless separately assigned.

features.description: Dōn means do/perform with an accusative work/thing in the selected elementary clauses, complements and commands.
features.evidence_request: Audited dōn accusative-object frame.
features.scope_note: No causative, passive, perfect or arbitrary phrasal sense.
